description: Fondazione IPRES publishes puglia municipal bank branches, lending and deposits, 2017–2025. Municipal banking indicators for 2017–2025 report branch counts, lending and deposits per resident, average deposit/lending volumes and the lending-to-deposit ratio. The Bank of Italy is the underlying source. These describe financial-service provision and operations. Individual branch addresses, banking-network connections and transaction-level observations are not established. Coverage is the Puglia region of Italy. The native catalogue provides CSV and spreadsheet distributions, with some linked visualisations. These alternative representations remain one resource; file contents and data rows were not inspected. The native licence is Creative Commons Attribution without a stated version. The national metadata mirror specifies version 4.0; the native statement remains unversioned. Metadata access is public, while file-use charges and restrictions are not established. Completeness and numerical accuracy are unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related national and regional catalogue representations are treated as the same publication only where their exact source identities match.
